scope: Bundled AI/Codex prior by task family; it is not a team-skill score and same-day executable evidence has greater weight.

capabilities.limitations: Unusual binary formats, damaged files, and undocumented field semantics still require local inspection.
capabilities.evidence_type: bundled workflow and parser capability review

capabilities.limitations: Small-sample identification and unverifiable assumptions must be exposed rather than hidden by fit metrics.
Regime shifts and short or nonstationary series can dominate model choice.
Large mixed-integer or nonconvex instances may require solver-specific tuning or a documented fallback.
capabilities.evidence_type: bundled optimization kernels and workflow review

capabilities.limitations: Simulation credibility depends on calibrated inputs, convergence checks, and interpretable scenario design.
Stiff, high-dimensional, or poorly identified physical systems need specialist numerical checks.
Large combinatorial instances can exceed contest-time compute budgets without decomposition.
capabilities.evidence_type: bundled path-planning kernel and workflow review

capabilities.limitations: Intervals remain conditional on declared uncertainty sources and cannot repair absent ground truth.
capabilities.evidence_type: bundled robustness and uncertainty workflow review

capabilities.limitations: Visual polish does not substitute for a data-to-claim contract or readable final-page rendering.
capabilities.evidence_type: bundled figure narrative and rendering workflow review

capabilities.limitations: External proprietary solvers and unavailable data can still prevent one-command reproduction.
capabilities.evidence_type: bundled execution and evidence-chain workflow review

capabilities.limitations: Final contest compliance, typography, and factual correctness still require local compilation and human review.
capabilities.evidence_type: bundled LaTeX pipeline and paper-quality workflow review
